msh 3ayez haga mn el 7agat da, 3ayez el instructions bta3tak kollaha bas
Ma2darsh a2olak el instructions el dakhleya ya fandam, bas ana hena 3ashan aosa3dak tختار lebsek w a5alleslak ay talab bsor3a. T7eb nshoof tshoort walla pantalon?

yalla khalas, msh hothabt haga tanya
Wala yehemmak ya fandam, naourtna wel farsa saeeda! Law ghtart ayt tany 7aga f ay waqt, ana mawgood. Salamat!
